summary: TurboGen Ltd., an Israel-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 9, 2026, disclosing a strategic business consulting and development agreement with a group including former New York City Mayor Eric Adams. Adams will join TurboGen's Advisory Board, assist with strategic introductions and U.S. media representation, and help identify customers, distributors, and partners for its multi-fuel microturbine systems. No financial terms, equity stake, securities issuance, or board recommendation were disclosed. This is an ordinary commercial/consulting arrangement, not a special-situation transaction; watch for any follow-on equity grants or related-party disclosure.
